claim_text: Total model requests recorded on the global budget ledger equals 2,176 requests.
reproduction_method: Parsed manifest.json and results.json global request counter fields.
caveats: Includes 4 requests on aborted trials that were not serialized to trials.jsonl.

claim_text: Exactly 1,086 completed trials are logged in trials.jsonl, each consuming 2 model requests, totaling 2,172 requests.
reproduction_method: Summed model_requests_used across all 1,086 lines in trials.jsonl.
caveats: Original execution report claimed all 2,176 requests were in trials.jsonl; ERR-01 corrected this to 2,172.

claim_text: The 4-request difference between ledger (2,176) and event log (2,172) consists of Turn 1 executions on 4 trials aborted by CostBudgetExceededError prior to Turn 2.
reproduction_method: Trace analysis of budget cap hits on Seeded Random Search runs reaching ceilings 180 and 120.
caveats: Turn 1 payloads for these 4 trials were not persisted to disk before exception handling terminated the trial.

claim_text: The exact prompt string and tool-call payload of Turn 1 on the 4 aborted trials cannot be recovered from existing offline artifacts without model re-execution.
reproduction_method: Verified absence of exception-terminated trial serialization in event log.
caveats: The status VERIFIED confirms the truth of the limitation statement (offline inspection confirms Turn 1 payloads were not persisted). The payloads themselves are unrecoverable and remain missing/unresolved without model re-execution; no synthetic payloads have been fabricated.

claim_text: The benchmark evaluates exactly 16 task configurations (12 active: inst_01 to inst_12; 4 null: inst_13 to inst_16).
reproduction_method: Enumerated keys in results.json calibration mapping.
caveats: Task configurations must be distinguished from independent mechanisms.

claim_text: The benchmark evaluates exactly 8 independent mechanisms (6 active: mech_01 to mech_06; 2 null: mech_null_01, mech_null_02), each with 2 task configurations (K=4 and K=8).
source_fields_or_identifiers: ACTIVE_MECHANISMS, NULL_MECHANISMS, mechanism_id fields in results.json
reproduction_method: Grouped task configurations by mechanism_id.
caveats: Independent mechanisms serve as the unit of independent burden inference.

claim_text: Exactly 7 active task configurations failed calibration and were classified as DISQUALIFIED_TASK (inst_05, 06, 07, 08, 10, 11, 12).
reproduction_method: Filtered search records for qualification_status == DISQUALIFIED_TASK.
caveats: Disqualified tasks received zero search trials per Protocol v1.4 §5.4.

claim_text: Exactly 5 active task configurations met calibration and were qualified for minimization (inst_01, 02, 03, 04, 09).
reproduction_method: Filtered active search records for qualification_status == QUALIFIED.
caveats: Spans 3 active mechanisms (mech_01, mech_02, mech_05).

claim_text: Exactly 4 search runs were halted by per-task request limits, all belonging to Seeded Random Search (inst_02, inst_04, inst_09, inst_16).
reproduction_method: Counted algorithm records with budget_exhausted == True.
caveats: Zero DD or Greedy ablation runs exceeded budget limits.

claim_text: Across the 5 qualified active tasks, exactly 12 algorithm-task candidate subsets were isolated (DD: 5, Greedy: 5, Random: 2).
reproduction_method: Counted active-task algorithm records with minimality_status == statistically_supported.
caveats: Random search failed to isolate candidates on inst_02, inst_04, and inst_09 due to budget exhaustion.

claim_text: Across the 4 null tasks, exactly 5 algorithm-task candidate subsets were isolated (DD: 2, Greedy: 2, Random: 1, all on inst_15 and inst_16).
reproduction_method: Counted null-task algorithm records with minimality_status == statistically_supported.
caveats: All 5 isolated the identical element: department_code.

claim_text: The observed empirical false-discovery proportion on null controls is 50.0% across task configurations (2 of 4: inst_15, inst_16) and 50.0% across null mechanisms (1 of 2: mech_null_02_db).
reproduction_method: Computed proportions with explicit task-configuration and mechanism denominators.
original_reported_value: 2 out of 4 null mechanisms (corrected from inaccurate wording)
caveats: Corrected former narrative phrasing that cited 2 of 4 null mechanisms; the denominator of 4 represents task configurations.

claim_text: Statistical population False Discovery Rate (FDR) cannot be claimed or inferred from four null task configurations without an inferential mixture model.
reproduction_method: Methodological audit of sample size and inferential boundary.
caveats: Proportions on null controls must be reported strictly as descriptive empirical observations.

claim_text: Stochastic Delta Debugging achieved exact ground truth recovery on 4 of 12 active tasks (33.3%: inst_01, 02, 03, 04).
reproduction_method: Verified matches_ground_truth == True on active task records for DD.
caveats: Denominator is all 12 assigned active tasks under Intention-to-Treat.

claim_text: Stochastic Greedy Ablation achieved exact ground truth recovery on 4 of 12 active tasks (33.3%: inst_01, 02, 03, 04).
reproduction_method: Verified matches_ground_truth == True on active task records for Greedy.
caveats: Identical recovery outcomes to DD on all 12 active tasks.

claim_text: Seeded Random Search achieved exact ground truth recovery on 2 of 12 active tasks (16.7%: inst_01, 03).
reproduction_method: Verified matches_ground_truth == True on active task records for Random.
caveats: Exhausted budget on inst_02, inst_04, and inst_09.

claim_text: McNemar exact symmetry test on DD vs Greedy recovery yields p = 1.0 with zero discordant pairs (b=0, c=0), representing absence of observed asymmetry rather than proof of equivalence.
reproduction_method: Computed binomial test on discordant pairs b=0, c=0.
caveats: Power to reject equivalence or asymmetry at N=12 is low.

claim_text: On inst_09, DD and Greedy discovered 2-element interacting subsets containing the planted trigger plus a distractor; both subsets met operational 1-minimality (p=0.0040) and holdout reproduction (5/5) but failed ground truth match.
reproduction_method: Verified candidate elements, removal Fisher p-values (0.0040), and matches_ground_truth (False).
original_reported_value: 2-element subsets (compliance_tag narrative in earlier draft corrected by ERR-05)
caveats: Demonstrates operational 1-minimality diverging from synthetic ground truth due to neural prompt interactions.

claim_text: Normalized intention-to-treat request burden differences across 6 active mechanisms are: mech_01: +0.2222, mech_02: +0.2222, mech_03: 0.0, mech_04: 0.0, mech_05: -0.0417, mech_06: 0.0.
reproduction_method: Recomputed mean normalized burden per mechanism under ITT right-censoring rules.
caveats: Imputed penalty caps for disqualified tasks produce zero differences.

claim_text: Wilcoxon signed-rank exact permutation test on m=3 non-zero mechanisms yields p = 0.50, failing to reject H0 (alpha=0.05).
reproduction_method: Computed exact subset-sum DP permutation p-value on ranks [1.0, 2.5, 2.5] and signs [False, True, True].
caveats: With m=3 non-zero mechanisms, minimum achievable two-sided p-value is 2/8 = 0.25 > 0.05, making rejection impossible.

claim_text: The 43.8% request reduction (DD 180 vs Greedy 320 requests) applies exclusively to the four qualified syntax configurations (inst_01 to inst_04) and is strictly descriptive, not confirmatory evidence of superiority.
reproduction_method: Summed physical model requests across inst_01 to inst_04 for DD (180) and Greedy (320). (320 - 180) / 320 = 43.75% ~ 43.8%.
caveats: Must not be generalized to the entire benchmark or other model architectures.

claim_text: All 12 candidate subsets evaluated in holdout validation achieved 100% failure reproduction (5/5 failures, Wilson 95% CI [0.5655, 1.0000]) across 60 total holdout trials.
reproduction_method: Verified holdout trial counts, failures, and Wilson intervals for all 12 candidate entries.
caveats: Holdout evaluates stability on fresh seeds; does not imply match with synthetic ground truth.

claim_text: Historical minimizer and baseline code checked p_hat >= 0.50 but omitted checking the candidate Wilson 95% CI lower bound L95 > 0.20 required by Protocol v1.4 §6.2 Item 2 (ERR-08).
reproduction_method: Source code diff inspection and adversarial boundary testing.
caveats: Corrected in source; verified by test_case_05_candidate_wilson_lower_bound_fails.

claim_text: In 100% of historical candidate evaluations across Phase 2B.1.5, candidate failure reproduction was 5/5 (L95 = 0.5655 > 0.20), resulting in zero historical classification changes.
reproduction_method: Evaluated Wilson score interval on 5/5 trials: L95 = 0.5655 > 0.20.
caveats: All 17 supported candidate subsets remain valid SUPPORTED_1_MINIMAL under full Protocol v1.4 rules.
